concept: Marbled stage with watchful sun relic
creativeDirection: A theatrical mixed-media paper-cut and screenprint tableau, combining marbled ink textures, collage strips, and painted classical fragments into a surreal proscenium scene.
scene: A frontal view into a dark surreal theater stage where a large white marbled void opens like a spotlighted performance floor, bordered by swirling black-and-gray ink textures as if curtains of smoke are parting.

elements.element: A distressed yellow spiked sun-mask with a rough blue center and two oversized eye-like ovals hangs above the stage as the dominant watchful emblem.

A row of alternating black and white side-profile cutouts with hot pink edges forms a frieze along one side of the proscenium, with the tiny female figure reduced to a small poster-like accent in an upper corner.
Vertical torn white paper strips with bold black marks descend stage right over a red-purple checker pattern, intersected by sharp yellow bands like set pieces.

Classical pastoral bodies and animals appear as painted fragmentary performers and props around the stage edge: a leaping draped figure, a snake-bound torso, and hints of dog, donkey, and spotted cat.
A large crouching black silhouette in a hat reaches from the lower foreground into the white void, acting as the main human-scale figure.
Four partially obscured faces become dim audience-box apparitions in the surrounding darkness, blocked by purple paint rectangles and magenta scuffs.
A slender red-and-white striped vertical figure stands deep center in the void, with only a faint pale face and red lips emerging from shadow nearby.
The entire stage opening and atmosphere are built from black-gray marbled swirls surrounding a stark white center.

coverSummaries.description: A bold abstract image fills the square: a bright yellow sunburst-like shape with uneven radiating spikes sits on a red background. At the center is a rough blue oval or face-like form containing two large white-rimmed black oval shapes resembling eyes. The image has a distressed, screen-printed look with splattered edges.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: sunburst with two oversized eye-like ovals

coverSummaries.description: A high-contrast graphic design with multiple side-profile silhouettes of faces arranged in a row across the cover. The profiles alternate between black and white shapes with hot pink outlines and background areas. A small cartoon-like standing female figure appears in a narrow panel at the upper left. The composition is flat, angular, and poster-like.

coverSummaries.album: History Never Repeats The Best Of Split Enz
coverSummaries.description: An abstract geometric cover made of a repeating checkerboard-like pattern in red and purple, overlaid with black oval and bar shapes clustered toward the upper left. Along the right side, a vertical stack of torn white paper pieces carries large black characters, creating a collage effect. Bright yellow horizontal bands cut across the composition.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: vertical stack of torn white paper pieces on a geometric patterned background

coverSummaries.description: A Renaissance-style painted scene with several human figures in a pastoral outdoor setting. In the foreground and center, partially nude figures pose dynamically around a stone structure; one long-haired figure strides or leaps with draped fabric, another muscular figure has a snake wrapped around the body, and others gesture with raised arms. Animals including a spotted big cat, a dark dog, and a donkey appear around them. Trees, distant hills, and a blue sky form the background.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: group of dramatic nude and semi-nude figures in a classical pastoral scene
coverSummaries.medium: classical oil painting reproduction with photomontage-like altered faces

coverSummaries.description: A stark black-and-white cover showing a large central silhouette of a crouching or lunging human figure with one hand extended toward the viewer. The figure wears a brimmed hat, bulky clothing, and a chain necklace. Behind the silhouette is a circular halftone pattern, and the background is divided into horizontal black and white bands.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: crouching black silhouette with outstretched hand and hat

coverSummaries.description: A dark collage-like portrait cover with four male faces partially visible against a black painted field. Broad purple brushstroke rectangles obscure parts of each face, creating a fragmented arrangement around the center. The outer border has rough magenta-red painted edges, and the overall look is moody and distressed.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: four partially obscured faces covered by purple paint blocks

coverSummaries.description: A minimalist, mostly black cover with a narrow vertical figure or draped form near the center, defined by slim red and white stripes. In the upper left area, part of a pale face with red lips emerges from the darkness. The composition is sparse, elegant, and heavily shadowed.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: slender central striped figure emerging from blackness
coverSummaries.medium: stylized studio photograph or photographic graphic

coverSummaries.description: A monochrome abstract image resembling marbled liquid or ink swirling around the edges of the frame. The center is a large irregular white void, while black, gray, and white organic textures form a ring around it. Small floating blot-like shapes appear within the central open area.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: large white central void surrounded by marbled black-and-gray swirls
coverSummaries.medium: abstract fluid painting or ink marbling

prompt: Frontal view into a surreal theater stage, where a large irregular white void forms the performance floor at center and black-and-gray marbled swirls curl around it like ink curtains parting; a distressed yellow spiked sun-mask with a rough blue center and two oversized white-rimmed black eyes hangs above as the dominant emblem, while a large crouching black silhouette in a brimmed hat reaches one hand into the bright void from the lower foreground; along stage left, a row of alternating black and white side-profile faces edged in hot pink forms a sharp poster-like proscenium frieze, with a tiny standing female figure tucked into a narrow upper-corner panel; stage right is built from a red-and-purple checker geometry overlaid by a vertical stack of torn white paper strips with bold black marks and crossed by bright yellow bands; around the edges of the white floor, fragmentary Renaissance painted figures and animals appear as theatrical set pieces and performers, including one draped leaping body, one muscular snake-wrapped torso, and subtle dog, donkey, and spotted big-cat details; deep in the center stands a slender narrow figure defined by red and white stripes, nearly swallowed by darkness, with only a faint pale face and red lips nearby; in the surrounding blackness, four dim audience-box faces emerge in collage fragments, each partially obscured by broad purple paint blocks and rough magenta edging; mixed-media paper-cut collage, screenprint textures, marbled ink, torn-paper assemblage, and painted classical fragments, visibly handmade and distressed; strong central hierarchy with the white void and sun-mask leading, the crouching silhouette anchoring the foreground, asymmetrical but balanced composition, dramatic spotlight effect from the void against velvety darkness; palette of black, white, gray, yellow, red, hot pink, purple, and a touch of blue, moody, theatrical, enigmatic, and watchful. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
